name: Kling AI CLI Skill
tagline: Use Kling Image 4.0 and the official CLI in Cline
description: Official Kling AI CLI Skill for prompt planning and image/video workflows, reusable Elements, motion control, and task tracking. For image generation, it prefers Kling Image 4.0 when the live tool list confirms availability and fit. Pair it with the matching CLI package and OAuth MCP connection: `@klingai/cli-global` for Global or `@klingai/cli-cn` for China. Generation consumes credits from the signed-in regional account.

install.notes: Install this skill with `cline skill install klingai-tech/skills` (the repo also documents `npx skills add klingai-tech/skills`). Install the matching npm CLI separately: `@klingai/cli-global` for Global or `@klingai/cli-cn` for China. Then complete OAuth with the same region's Kling account. Generation uses that account's credits.
